verses.en: Praise ye the LORD. Blessed is the man that feareth the LORD, that delighteth greatly in his commandments.
verses.sm: Atua la outou vivii atu i le ALII. Arawa le tagata o lē mataʻu i le ALII, o loo o fiafia tele i ana poloaiga.

verses.en: His seed shall be mighty upon earth: the generation of the upright shall be blessed.
verses.sm: E malolosi lana fanau i le nuu; e manuia le tupulaga o e amiotonu. E i lona fale le oloa ma mea e tele;

verses.en: Wealth and riches shall be in his house: and his righteousness endureth for ever.
verses.sm: e tumau foi lana amiotonu e faavavau. F alu ae le malamalama i le pouliuli mo e ua amiotonu;

verses.en: Unto the upright there ariseth light in the darkness: he is gracious, and full of compassion, and righteous.
verses.sm: o ia o le alofa fua, ma lē alofa mutimuti vale, ma lē amiotonu.

verses.en: A good man sheweth favour, and lendeth: he will guide his affairs with discretion.
verses.sm: E manuia le tagata ua alofa fua, ma tuuina atu ana mea i e nono mai; na te tausia ana mea ma le faautauta tonu.

verses.en: Surely he shall not be moved for ever: the righteous shall be in everlasting remembrance.
verses.sm: E moni, e le faagaeetia o ia e faavavau; e manatua le tagata amiotonu E faavavau.

verses.en: He shall not be afraid of evil tidings: his heart is fixed, trusting in the LORD.
verses.sm: E le mataʻu o ia í le tala leaga; ua mau lona loto, o loo faalagolago i le ALII.

verses.en: His heart is established, he shall not be afraid, until he see his desire upon his enemies.
verses.sm: Ua mausali lona loto, e le fefe lava ia, seia iloa atu e ia le taui o e ita ia te ia. Ua faasalalauina e ia ana mea,

verses.en: He hath dispersed, he hath given to the poor; his righteousness endureth for ever; his horn shall be exalted with honour.
verses.sm: ua avatua E ia i e matitiva; e tumau lana amiotonu e faavavau; e faamaualugaina lona nifo ma le mamalu.

verses.en: The wicked shall see it, and be grieved; he shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away: the desire of the wicked shall perish.
verses.sm: E iloa atu ai e le tagata amio leaga, ona ita ai lea o ia; e lilivau ona nifo, e liu suávai lava ia; e faaumatia le manao o e amio leaga. N SALAMO 113,
